name: Giant Owl
otherStatistics: Perception +5. Stealth +4. Darkvision 120 ft. Passive Perception 15. Speaks Giant Owl. Common, Elvish and Sylvan are understood only.
appearance: A broad-chested tawny owl with barred flight feathers, a round facial disc, and heavy talons.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, D&D Basic Rules v1.0 (November 2018), Chapter 12, p. 134.
sections.Traits:
Flyby. Leaving an enemy’s reach in flight does not provoke an opportunity attack.
Keen Hearing and Sight. The owl has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that use hearing or sight.
sections.Actions: Talons. Melee weapon attack, +3 to hit with 5-ft. reach against one target. Hit for 8 (2d6 + 1) slashing damage.

name: Giant Poisonous Snake
otherStatistics: Perception +2. Blindsight 10 ft. Passive Perception 12. No listed languages.
appearance: A thick olive-brown snake with dark markings, a triangular head, and visible fangs.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, D&D Basic Rules v1.0 (November 2018), Chapter 12, p. 134.
sections.Actions: Bite. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit with 10-ft. reach against one target. On a hit, deal 6 (1d4 + 4) piercing damage. The target makes a DC 11 Constitution save, taking 10 (3d6) poison damage on a failure or half as much on a success.

name: Giant Rat
otherStatistics: Darkvision 60 ft. Passive Perception 10. No listed languages.
appearance: A stocky brown-gray rat with rounded ears, a pointed whiskered snout, and a long bare ringed tail.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, D&D Basic Rules v1.0 (November 2018), Chapter 12, p. 135.
sections.Traits:
Keen Smell. The rat has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that use scent.
Pack Tactics. The rat has advantage on attacks against a creature if one of the rat’s allies is within 5 ft. of that creature and that ally is not incapacitated.
sections.Actions: Bite. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit with 5-ft. reach against one target. Hit for 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

sections.Variant: Diseased Giant Rats: CR 1/8 (25 XP). Replace the standard Bite with this version. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit with 5-ft. reach against one target. Hit for 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage. A creature hit must pass a DC 10 Constitution save or contract a disease. While infected, the creature can regain HP only through magic and its HP maximum drops by 3 (1d6) every 24 hours. If this disease brings its maximum HP to 0, the creature dies.
